theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rdb_rescaled_integral_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (X : Euclidean N → Euclidean N), 0 < t → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → ∫ z, Varifold.tangentialDivergence X z.1 z.2 ∂(rescaledMeasure V x t) = t⁻¹ ^ n * V.firstVariation (fun z : Euclidean N ↦ t • X (t⁻¹ • (z - x)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
